newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise, backed by weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise, backed by weak yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Tuesday, as technical buying gathered force backed by the yen's slip against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.8 yen to 2.0 yen per kg firmer. Benchmark June was up 1.3 yen at 147.1 yen.
The market started the day on a firmer note, with bullish sentiment carried over from the previous day.
"Market sentiment has improved on technicals after the benchmark January broke above 140 yen, which was considered a psychological support," one trader said.
